argv:

                s = s + i
                s = s - 1
                s = s * 2
                s = s % 1000000
            end
            return s
        end
        
        -- Float arithmetic loop
        local function loop2()
            local s = 0.0
            for i = 1, 500 do
                s = s + i
                s = s * 1.1
                s = s / 1.05
            end
            return s
        end
        
        -- Table access loop
        local t = {}
        for i = 1, 100 do t[i] = i end
        local function loop3()
            local s = 0
            for i = 1, 500 do
                s = s + t[i % 100 + 1]
            end
            return s
        end
        
        -- Mixed operations loop
        local function loop4()
            local s = 0
            for i = 1, 500 do
                if i % 2 == 0 then
                    s = s + i
                else
                    s = s - i
                end
            end
            return s
        end
        
        -- Call them multiple times to ensure compilation
        for i = 1, 5 do
            results[#results+1] = loop1()
            results[#results+1] = loop2()
            results[#results+1] = loop3()
            results[#results+1] = loop4()
        end
